androidtv.notes: One look on every device: the same menus, colours, bold font, chips and settings rows as the other Codio apps.

phone.notes: Codio for Android and for iPhone are now the same screens: Home, Search, Library, Settings and the tab bar match, with the same colours, font, chips and settings rows as the TV and Windows apps. New in Settings: Mini player, and When Codio opens (ask who's watching).

windows.notes: One look on every device: Settings headings, Library labels and text now match the TV and phone apps.
